title: Slice checks skip the Acceptance criteria list
lead: In a slice's Check section, bullets after a line `Acceptance criteria:` and up to a line `Commands:` are prose: ork never runs them and never classifies them as Check commands. A Check section without those lines behaves as today.
findings_note: 2026-11-17: run ork-20261117-021246-a004 (S387) paused with 'slice checks: friction: exec: "friction": executable file not found in $PATH'. `sliceCheckCommands` (`internal/engine/brief.go:413-427`) takes every backticked span in the Check section as a command, including spans inside the prose of an "Acceptance criteria:" list.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner rule (2026-11-17): deterministic, regular steps are code. Slice specs now open Check with an "Acceptance criteria:" list of observable outcomes, then the runnable commands. `sliceCheckCommands` (`internal/engine/brief.go:413-427`) splits each Check entry on backticks and treats every odd span as a command; it skips only `HUMAN CHECK` and `[AFTER LAND]` entries. So a backticked word in a criterion is run before the gate (`internal/engine/states.go:884`, `runSliceChecks` at `:1039`), and a word that is not a program pauses the run with a missing-command error (findings; `TestSliceChecksMissingCommandPauses`, `internal/engine/slicechecks_test.go:331`). The same function feeds the brief's Check classification (`internal/engine/brief.go:369-404`), so criteria also reach the spec check as commands.

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): bullets between `Acceptance criteria:` and `Commands:` are skipped [checks.acceptance-criteria, adj 448].

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/brief.go:413-427` (`sliceCheckCommands`: skip the criteria block)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:561-580` (`sliceChecklistSections`, the Check text it reads)
- `internal/engine/slicechecks_test.go`
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go`
- `docs/design.md:1551-1562` (the S317 paragraph under Roles)
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestSliceChecksSkipAcceptanceCriteria` (`internal/engine/slicechecks_test.go`): a Check section `Acceptance criteria:
- the run prints `friction` once

Commands:
- `true` exits 0.` gives exactly one check record, command `true`, OK; no record names `friction`. Red: today `friction` is run and the run pauses with `exec: "friction": executable file not found in $PATH`.
- `TestSliceChecksWithoutCriteriaUnchanged`: a Check section with no `Acceptance criteria:` line and two backticked commands gives the same two records as today. Guards today's behavior.
- `TestCheckSectionsSkipAcceptanceCriteria` (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): the spec-check brief for the first fixture lists only `true` among the Check commands. Red: today it also lists `friction`.
- `TestSliceChecksCriteriaWithoutCommandsLine`: `Acceptance criteria:` with no later `Commands:` line skips every entry after it. Red as the first test.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red tests above.
2. In `sliceCheckCommands`, walk the Check text in order: a line that is `Acceptance criteria:` (trimmed) starts a skip, a line that is `Commands:` ends it; entries inside the skip add no command.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md` (the S317 paragraph). CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A slice whose Acceptance criteria quote a word in backticks runs only the commands under 'Commands:' before the gate.
- A slice whose Check has no 'Acceptance criteria:' line runs the same commands as before.

Commands:

- `go -C /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go -C /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork test ./...` exits 0.
